uploadDescription: Choose any file to publish in the public library.
libraryCaption: Saved files, ready whenever you are.
deleteDescription: The file will disappear from the library. Its download history will remain.
newDownloadDescription: Paste a link to a single video. We’ll take it from here.
urlHint: A single video, up to 1080p with audio. Playlists and live streams aren’t supported.
sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again to manage downloads.
cancelDescription: Processing will stop and temporary files will be removed. The history will remain.
historyRefreshFailed: History could not be refreshed. The last confirmed data is shown.
continuationFallback: This attempt continues from a saved stage.

explanations.media_plan_missing: The saved media plan is unavailable. This attempt restores downloading.
explanations.artifacts_unavailable: A required file is missing or its size/checksum changed. This attempt restores the earliest necessary stage.
explanations.publication_reconciliation: An existing publication was found. This attempt verifies it before uploading again.

emptyLibraryDescription: Published files will appear here, ready to download.
emptyDownloadsDescription: Add a video to start your first download.
fileDeleteQueued: Deletion queued. The file remains available until removal is confirmed.
downloadRetried: A new attempt has been added to the queue.
downloadCanceled: Cancellation requested. Processing must stop and cleanup finish before it is canceled.

errors.metadata_failed: The source metadata could not be read.
errors.process_stop_unconfirmed: Stopping could not be confirmed. Recreate the application container before retrying.
errors.artifacts_unavailable: A missing or changed file requires an earlier stage.
errors.delete_failed: Deletion could not be confirmed. Retry deletion from the saved stage.
errors.playlist_not_supported: Use a link to one video. Playlists are not supported.
errors.live_not_supported: Live and upcoming streams are not supported.
errors.format_unavailable: No suitable video with audio up to 1080p is available.
errors.download_failed: The media download failed. Its files were kept for retry.
errors.prepare_failed: The media could not be prepared. Downloaded tracks were kept.
errors.probe_failed: The downloaded media could not be verified.
errors.tool_unavailable: A required media tool is unavailable. Contact the administrator.
errors.cancel_failed: Cleanup could not finish. Retry cancellation.
errors.interrupted: Processing was interrupted. You can retry from the saved stage.
errors.invalid_upload: Choose one valid file and try again.
errors.invalid_title: Enter up to 255 characters without control characters.
errors.storage_unavailable: Storage is unavailable. Publication has not been confirmed. Please try again later.
errors.publication_changed: This file changed or its download is still processing. Refresh the library before trying again.
errors.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS video URL without credentials.
errors.url_conflict: This source could not be registered safely. Please contact the administrator.
errors.download_already_exists: This URL is already in your downloads. Use Retry on the existing download.
errors.invalid_state: This action is unavailable in the current state. Refresh and try again.
errors.not_found: This item is no longer available.
errors.request_failed: Couldn’t complete the request. Please try again.
errors.upload_failed: The file couldn’t be uploaded. You can retry from this stage.
errors.cleanup_failed: The file is available in the library, but local cleanup needs a retry.
errors.access_denied: This account does not have administrator access.
errors.login_failed: Sign-in could not be completed. Please try again.
errors.antiforgery_failed: The session changed. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.forbidden: This account does not have administrator access.
